# JPMorgan and Bank of America 2024 Financial Comparison and Expectation Testing

**Insufficient evidence**

For fiscal year 2024, JPMorgan reported annual revenue of $177,556,000,000 and net income of $58,471,000,000 [E921a368daf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html) [E76102bdf7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html), while Bank of America reported annual revenue of $101,887,000,000 and net income of $27,132,000,000 [E54613ba754](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html) [Ea4c711410f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html). Annual operating income and capex metrics were not retrieved under supported XBRL tags as coverage gaps for both banks [E520eca78d5] [E310db47641] [Ea85cd7d8ec] [Ece97180a89]. Retrieved management expectations are qualitative or non-financial goals and cannot be tested against entity-wide financial outcomes [E08f55f4ece](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Efc97951369](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [E8adbdd0867](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Efc97373c99](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Ea0f3acf764](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000131/bac-20220930.htm) [E7869ad25c8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E0b15db1daa](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E0a70202dd5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E46f8866ef1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm).

## Numbers on record

JPM revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $177.556 billion [E921a368daf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html), up from $158.104 billion for 2023-12-31 [E2979af2545](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961724000225/0000019617-24-000225-index.html). JPM net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $58.471 billion [E76102bdf7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html), up from $49.552 billion for 2023-12-31 [E22bfa65dcd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961724000225/0000019617-24-000225-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2023, as-of date, historical financial records were available through fiscal year 2022 [E595de09ab9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961723000231/0000019617-23-000231-index.html) [Ea97cf19f34](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/0000070858-23-000092-index.html). For fiscal year 2022, JPMorgan reported revenue of $128,695,000,000 and net income of $37,676,000,000 [E595de09ab9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961723000231/0000019617-23-000231-index.html) [Effc6dc87c0](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961723000231/0000019617-23-000231-index.html). For the same period, Bank of America reported revenue of $94,950,000,000 and net income of $27,528,000,000 [Ea97cf19f34](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/0000070858-23-000092-index.html) [E6ef9ba4354](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/0000070858-23-000092-index.html). Management disclosures filed up to early 2023 included qualitative statements regarding stress capital buffers, emissions reduction targets, and risk modeling assumptions [Ea0f3acf764](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000131/bac-20220930.htm) [E7869ad25c8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E46f8866ef1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm).

## What happened later

Subsequent financial reporting through early 2025 captured full-year 2024 results for both institutions [E921a368daf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html) [E54613ba754](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html). JPMorgan reported 2024 annual revenue of $177,556,000,000 and net income of $58,471,000,000 [E921a368daf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html) [E76102bdf7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html). Bank of America reported 2024 annual revenue of $101,887,000,000 and net income of $27,132,000,000 [E54613ba754](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html) [Ea4c711410f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html). Annual operating income and capex figures remained absent from retrieved records due to coverage gaps under supported XBRL tags [E5498d85d67] [E6e7c7dd7b9] [E6e49a863e0] [E68c725b7c3].

## The peer test

Comparing the latest annual periods through the outcome cutoff, JPMorgan recorded fiscal year 2024 revenue of $177,556,000,000 (ending 2024-12-31) and net income of $58,471,000,000 (ending 2024-12-31) [E921a368daf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html) [E76102bdf7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html). Bank of America recorded fiscal year 2024 revenue of $101,887,000,000 (ending 2024-12-31) and net income of $27,132,000,000 (ending 2024-12-31) [E54613ba754](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html) [Ea4c711410f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html). Both banks share identical annual fiscal calendars ending on December 31. Neither bank retrieved annual operating income or capex metrics under supported tags [E5498d85d67] [E6e7c7dd7b9] [E6e49a863e0] [E68c725b7c3].

## Cross-examination

Retrieved management passages from Bank of America include statements on Value-at-Risk frequencies, tax expectations, unsecured funding management, and plans to set financing activity emission reduction targets [E08f55f4ece](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [E8adbdd0867](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Efc97373c99](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [E46f8866ef1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm). None of these represent verifiable quantitative financial guidance or operating targets for full-year 2024 results [E08f55f4ece](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Efc97951369](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [E8adbdd0867](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Efc97373c99](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Ea0f3acf764](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000131/bac-20220930.htm) [E7869ad25c8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E0b15db1daa](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E0a70202dd5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm) [E46f8866ef1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm). Consequently, all retrieved expectations are marked not testable against entity-wide financial outcomes.

## Limits

- Annual operating income and capex tags are absent under supported XBRL rules for both JPMorgan and Bank of America.
- Macroeconomic and price data are from hindsight context sources rather than as-of vintages known at historical decision dates.
